title: VAULT3 - Open source SDK to easily add token-gated content to any Cardano dapp or project

ms.promise:
・Project Infrastructure
・Codebase setup
・CI/CD
・Automatic testing
・UI/UX Design and Mockups
・Open-source Github link
ms.criteria: Infrastructure setup available on a public GitHub repository.
ms.report:
We set the project's infrastructure, codebase, CI/CD, and automatic testing on an open-source GitHub Repository.
The UI/UX Mockups are publicly available on this link. These designs include the token gate unlocking experience (Milestone 2) and token gate creation (Milestone 3). We took NMKR Studio as an example because it will be one of the first solutions integrating our services using this SDK.

ms.promise:
・Wallet connection
・Check of access condition via API
・Show call-to-actions or unlocked files
ms.criteria: It's possible to add our JavaScript SDK to a website, there will be a UI with the title and description of the token gate, and a wallet connect button to unlock. The token-gated content can be unlocked by users that fulfill the access conditions (checked via API). Finally, call to actions will be shown after successful or unsuccessful unlocks.
ms.report:
We created a demo page to showcase how the unlocking experience looks on a website that has integrated our SDK. However, we changed the endpoint where the working example will be hosted.
 old: https://dev.vault3.io/sdk.
 new: https://app.vault3.io/sdk.
The source code is available on our open-source GitHub Repository.

ms.promise:
・Create a token gate with name, description, access conditions, call-to-actions
・Add exclusive files to the token gate
・SDK authentication via API token
ms.criteria: Using the SDK UI with a valid API key, token gates can be created with customized access conditions, name, description, call-to-actions, and exclusive files.
ms.report:
We created a demo page to showcase how the token gate creation experience looks on a website that has integrated our SDK, This also includes access condition creation and linking, branding editing, adding exclusive files to space, and authentication via API token. However, we changed the endpoint where the working example will be hosted.
 old: https://dev.vault3.io/sdk.
 new: https://app.vault3.io/sdk.
The source code is available on our open-source GitHub Repository.

ms.promise: ・UI customization for token gate creation and unlocking
ms.criteria: The VAULT3 SDK can be customized to offer a seamless UI/UX experience on the client's website. This includes background color, buttons color, button text color, button on-hover color, button text on-hover color, text color, text font.
ms.report:
We released a beta version (100% free) with a demo page to showcase how the UI customization looks on a website that integrated our SDK.
With this milestone, we released a beta version that will be publicly announced to the Cardano community. We changed the endpoint where the admin dashboard and SDK demo will be hosted
 new: https://beta.app.vault3.io/sdk.
Use the dropdown on the top-right corner to change the theme of the SDK (2 themes supported), this will change the colors used in the JavaScript config and will update the colors, font family, and buttons in the UI. Also, customize the messages that are displayed to the users while unlocking the spaces using the input fields in the center of the demo page. These are also connected with the JavaScript config file that initializes the SDK.
Please keep in mind that we built this website only to show the product to Catalyst reviewers, so it's not fully featured as it will be deleted after the Milestones are approved.
The source code is available on our open-source GitHub Repository.

ms.promise:

ms.criteria: SDK is publicly available as a npm package and can be integrated with any partner project. A close-out video and report are publicly available on a VAULT3 token gate.
ms.report:
We launched a beta version of our SDK for 10 weeks under beta.app.vault3.io/sdk to gather feedback and fix bugs. Now we have released the production version of the VAULT3 SDK on:
Close-out video product demo: https://youtu.be/sRRg43YhuE4
Close-out video product final thoughts: https://youtu.be/sqekd9sE8uw
Close-out report: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Z9eAEr17XHkULMqhLnUv34u53TrgcZ161ILhWrHw01A/edit?tab=t.jx29hcp86twa
NPM Package for React SDK: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vault3/sdk
NPM Package for VanillaJS SDK: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vault3/sdk-vanilla
Demo website for React SDK: https://app.vault3.io/sdk.
Demo website for JS SDK: https://vault3-io.github.io
Open source repo for the SDK: https://github.com/vault3-io/vault3-sdk
Finally, we also hosted the close-out videos (mp4) and report (pdf) on a VAULT3 space: https://vault3.io/space/catalyst-vault3-sdk.
